name: advance-terminal-standalone
description: Advance Terminal V6 by Artlie Digital. A Windows desktop terminal workspace with reusable local shell profiles, SSH connections, server management, terminal actions, audit logs, reports, and safe clipboard controls.

scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:foundation
scripts.check:syntax: node --check src/main/main.js && node --check src/main/preload.js && node --check src/main/store.js && node --check src/main/secret-store.js && node --check src/main/key-manager.js && node --check src/main/terminal-manager.js && node --check src/renderer/js/renderer-foundation.js && node --check src/renderer/js/renderer-terminal-helpers.js && node --check src/renderer/js/renderer-connection-helpers.js && node --check src/renderer/js/renderer-report-helpers.js && node --check src/renderer/renderer.js
scripts.pack:win: npm run check && electron-builder --win dir --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run check && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.release:win: npm run check && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish always
scripts.release:win:draft: npm run check && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish onTagOrDraft

author: Artlie Digital
